title: Common Core of Data (CCD) Public School and LEA Universe
accessMethod: Primary bulk files; optional Urban Institute API mirror for bounded extracts
unitOfAnalysis: Public school or local education agency, annual
yearsCovered: Annual releases; verify source vintage before analysis
notes: Use as the canonical public-school identifier backbone. CCD is descriptive and is not an intervention-effect dataset.

title: Stanford Education Data Archive (SEDA), Version 6.0
accessMethod: Public CSV and Stata downloads with codebooks
unitOfAnalysis: Geographic education unit and student subgroup
yearsCovered: Use the currently released SEDA v6 files and technical documentation
joinKeys: NCES-derived school and district identifiers where supplied
notes: Best national comparability layer for achievement; retain SEDA version and aggregation level in every derived claim.

title: EDFacts / Ed Data Express
accessMethod: Custom CSV downloads and released ZIP files with data notes
unitOfAnalysis: Education agency or school, annual and subgroup-disaggregated
yearsCovered: Varies by file specification and outcome
notes: Preserve file specification, data group, data notes, suppression rules, and denominator with each extract.

title: Civil Rights Data Collection (CRDC)
steward: U.S. Department of Education Office for Civil Rights
unitOfAnalysis: Public school and district, collection-year and subgroup-disaggregated
notes: Treat changing collection definitions and suppressed values as part of the analytic record.

title: Annual Survey of School System Finances (F-33)
accessMethod: Downloadable files and Census API; API key required for current API queries
unitOfAnalysis: Public elementary-secondary school system, fiscal year
yearsCovered: 2012-2024 in the published time-series API; historical files available separately
notes: Deflate monetary values and document fiscal-year alignment before comparing programs.

title: NAEP Data Explorer
accessMethod: Custom tables, charts, and restricted-use microdata for qualified users
yearsCovered: Assessment-specific, with trend series extending across decades
notes: NAEP is not school-level and should not be used alone to attribute initiative effects.

title: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS)
accessMethod: Downloadable complete data files and custom data tools
notes: Institutional outcomes are not direct student-level follow-up for a K-12 initiative.

title: College Scorecard
unitOfAnalysis: Postsecondary institution and student cohort summaries
notes: Use cohort definitions exactly as released and do not treat institution-level averages as individual program effects.

title: Urban Institute Education Data Portal
primaryMeasures: Convenient access to CCD, CRDC, EDFacts, IPEDS, and related public data
notes: Use the originating agency as the authoritative provenance in published claims.

title: Education Resources Information Center (ERIC)
accessMethod: Public search interface and JSON API; bounded query exports only
notes: Discovery metadata, not an intervention-outcome dataset. Preserve the query and retrieval date for every bounded export.

title: National Teacher and Principal Survey (NTPS) and Teacher Follow-up Survey (TFS)
accessMethod: Public-use custom extracts through NCES DataLab; restricted-use files require a license
unitOfAnalysis: Sampled school, teacher, principal, and follow-up teacher record
yearsCovered: NTPS cycles every two to three years; predecessor SASS/TFS series extends to 1987
notes: Nationally representative survey context; it does not identify effects of a local initiative without a separate credible design.

title: Early Childhood Longitudinal Study, Kindergarten Class of 2010-11 (ECLS-K:2011)
accessMethod: Public-use child-level files, documentation, and setup files; restricted files require a license
unitOfAnalysis: Longitudinal child record with linked family, teacher, classroom, and school responses
yearsCovered: 2010 kindergarten entry through spring 2016 fifth grade for ECLS-K:2011
notes: Use NCES weights and follow cohort-specific comparability guidance; the public data are not a substitute for an experimental early-childhood evaluation.

title: High School Longitudinal Study of 2009 (HSLS:09)
accessMethod: Public-use custom extracts through NCES DataLab; restricted-use files require a license
unitOfAnalysis: Longitudinal student record with linked parent, teacher, counselor, school, transcript, and postsecondary records
yearsCovered: 2009 ninth-grade cohort through 2021 postsecondary administrative records
notes: National cohort context; school and student identifiers are suppressed in public-use files, so causal initiative evaluation requires a separate study design.

title: School Survey on Crime and Safety (SSOCS)
accessMethod: Public-use data files and documentation; restricted-use files require a license
notes: A nationally representative school survey, not a longitudinal impact evaluation or a school-level program-effect file.

title: Evidence for ESSA
steward: Center for Research and Reform in Education, Johns Hopkins University
notes: A review database that complements, rather than replaces, WWC and primary-study records.

title: National Student Clearinghouse Research Center Enrollment Insights
accessMethod: Public aggregate reports; student-level data require a separate research arrangement
unitOfAnalysis: Aggregate enrollment and persistence reporting series
notes: Aggregate public reporting is useful for context only; it cannot estimate the effect of a K-12 initiative on an individual student.

title: State Longitudinal Data Systems (SLDS) Program
accessMethod: State-administered systems; no single national public microdata file
primaryMeasures: postsecondary and workforce links where available
notes: This is an access and evaluation-design layer, not one downloadable national dataset. Any state extract must retain that state's data dictionary, approval record, and disclosure controls.

title: What Works Clearinghouse
accessMethod: Public evidence reviews and study-level exports
notes: A review repository, not an outcome dataset; preserve the primary study alongside any WWC assessment.
